concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts

concepts.name: system_role_message
concepts.gloss: a message whose role is system, meaning it was added by OpenAI

concepts.name: added_by_openai
concepts.gloss: the message was added by OpenAI rather than by the user or another party

ontology.gloss: M is a message with the system role, i.e. a message added by OpenAI
